villains.name: The Bubbler
goals: To get rid of all adults

villains.name: Mr. Pigeon
goals: To save the pigeons of Paris
To turn Paris into a paradise for pigeons by turning all humans into pigeons
villains.quote: Perfect timing, hootie ho! We're ready to greet them, aren't we? They're going to fall right into my trap. It won't be long before you get your Miraculous, friend.

villains.name: Stormy Weather
goals: To get revenge on everybody who turned her down
villains.quote: Hahahaha! I am Stormy Weather. The only weather girl who always gets the forecast right! And unfortunately for you, there's a freak icy front moving in right now!

villains.name: Timebreaker
goals: To go back in time to save a family heirloom from being broken
To wants to learn the secrets that Marinette is keeping from them so that they can be friends again
villains.quote: One and a half minutes. You won't be able to stop me where I'm going, Ladybug

villains.name: Copycat
goals: To replace Cat Noir and win Ladybug's heart
villains.quote: Don't mind me. Just stealing this painting. Go about your business.
